fields.status: WineMetalGL 3.2.0 remains the latest published release (2026-10-14). On 2026-10-16, merged PR #34 fixed GLSL line-continuation handling for shader compiler inputs. The maintainer reports that the 28 affected Godot shader variants compiled after the fix and that 61/61 host and 259/259 GPU tests passed. This is a targeted shader-compiler fix; the README’s documented game corpus and unsupported-feature list remain the compatibility references.

fields.status: The owner reports a playable native client on Windows, Linux and Apple Silicon macOS. The README reports all 281 differential parity harnesses passing on Linux and macOS, last audited 2026-10-13; this is parity for the compared harnesses. GitHub lists v2026.10.16.03 (published 2026-10-16 05:11 UTC, commit f188dfe) as the latest release; its notes cover chat camera input and trial chamber, vault, and trial spawner fixes. The README still labels v2026.10.13.1 as the latest release, so its release-summary section is stale. The new release notes also mention a sprint-jumping report the maintainers could not reproduce.
